fields.label: Allow Employees to Customize Their Own Layout
fields.description: If unchecked, no employee can enter Customize Mode, regardless of any other setting. (Enforced client-side in Phase 2 — this field just needs to exist and be readable from Phase 1 onward.)

fields.options: This is the baseline layout every employee sees, unless a Role Profile Layout or their own Personal Layout overrides it. It's seeded automatically to match the app's current structure the first time this site runs bench migrate after this feature is installed — edit the rows below to change what's shown/hidden and in what order by default.
